def transform(grid):
    # Repeat the non-background pattern by translation into blank rectangular
    # panels; the vertical divider is an axis of mirror symmetry.
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    sep=next((row[0] for row in grid if len(set(row))==1),None)
    if sep is None:return out
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if all(v==sep for v in grid[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if all(grid[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    rs=[0]+[r+1 for r in rows]; re=rows+[H]
    cs=[0]+[c+1 for c in cols]; ce=cols+[W]
    tiles=[(a,b,c,d) for a,b in zip(rs,re) for c,d in zip(cs,ce)]
    # source panel is the panel with most cells not equal to separator
    a,b,c,d=max(tiles,key=lambda t:sum(grid[y][x]!=sep for y in range(t[0],t[1]) for x in range(t[2],t[3])))
    h,w=b-a,d-c
    # keep all non-separator values, including background colors in source
    for i,(r0,r1) in enumerate(zip(rs,re)):
      for j,(c0,c1) in enumerate(zip(cs,ce)):
        if (r0,c0)==(a,c):continue
        for y in range(r0,min(r1,r0+h)):
          for x in range(c0,min(c1,c0+w)):
            sy=a+(y-r0); dx=x-c0
            sx=c+(w-1-dx if j%2 else dx)
            # Fill cells which are the tile's dominant background.
            vals=[grid[yy][xx] for yy in range(r0,r1) for xx in range(c0,c1)]
            bg=max(set(vals),key=vals.count)
            if grid[y][x]==bg:out[y][x]=grid[sy][sx]
    return out
